admission_transition.name: stego-service-inspection.hypershell-namespace-allocation.allocation
admission_transition.scope: One address replacement in the Gateway admission variable. All other cluster fields remain equal.

remaining: Connect the fixed listener inputs to the operator and test Job.
Change the generated admission policy with UID and resourceVersion checks and confirm type checking.
Restart the generated workers with the replacement binding.
Prove that fresh connections reach the replacement and cannot reach the old address.
Repeat the checks after worker restart and namespace recovery; check regeneration and cleanup.
limits: This fixture uses fixed IP addresses. It does not prove DNS tracking or RDS failover.
The test Pod must not supply operator policy or gain admission-policy write permission.
No DNS provider or Technology Preview feature was enabled.
